name: Cycling

instructions.description: Set the saddle so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Start pedaling easily and gradually increase cadence to your target effort.
Keep your trunk stable and shoulders relaxed while applying smooth pressure through the pedals.
Reduce pace progressively before dismounting or ending the session.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use route or bike-computer distance when available.
Match intensity to your training goal.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Ride on an incline to increase force demands and cardiovascular load.

commentsNotes: Avoid excessive knee flare during the downstroke.
Choose terrain and gearing that fit your conditioning level.
